product.name: Online Interior Design Service
product.description: A virtual interior design service providing personalized 3D room designs and curated furniture selections tailored to individual spaces and styles.

product.name: 3D Room Visualization and Rendering
product.description: A service that produces photorealistic 3D renderings of interior spaces to help clients visualize design concepts before implementation.

product.name: Personalized Furniture and Decor Curation
product.description: A curated selection of furniture and decor items tailored to the client’s design style and space requirements, available for direct purchase.

product.name: Style Quiz and Designer Matching
product.description: An online quiz that identifies a client’s interior design style and matches them with a compatible professional designer.

product.name: Mobile App for Design Interaction
product.description: A mobile application that allows clients to view, edit, and interact with their interior design projects and shopping lists anytime, anywhere.
